name: Retrieve Topk Repurposing Drugs From Disease Txgnn
description: Computes TxGNN model predictions for drug repurposing and returns the top predicted drugs with their scores for a given disease.
detailed_description: Computes TxGNN model predictions for drug repurposing and returns the top predicted drugs with their scores for a given disease.
when_to_use: When you need retrieve topk repurposing drugs from disease txgnn analysis

parameters.disease_name: [Required] The name of the disease for which to retrieve drug predictions (str)
parameters.k: [Optional] The number of top drug predictions to return (default: 5)
